parameters.query:
with old as (
  select id, due_at from deadlines where moodle_uid = $1::text
),
saved as (
  insert into deadlines (chat_id, source, moodle_uid, course, title, due_at)
  select $2::bigint, 'moodle', $1::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::timestamptz
  where $5::timestamptz > now()   -- only deadlines still to come
  on conflict (moodle_uid) do update
    set course     = excluded.course,
        title      = excluded.title,
        due_at     = excluded.due_at,
        -- a new date means the reminders start again
        reminded_7 = deadlines.reminded_7 and deadlines.due_at = excluded.due_at,
        reminded_3 = deadlines.reminded_3 and deadlines.due_at = excluded.due_at,
        reminded_1 = deadlines.reminded_1 and deadlines.due_at = excluded.due_at,
        updated_at = now()
  returning id, course, title, due_at
)
select s.id, s.course, s.title,
       case when o.id is null           then 'new'
            when o.due_at <> s.due_at   then 'moved'
            else 'same' end as action,
       to_char(o.due_at at time zone 'Europe/Paris', 'Dy DD Mon, HH24:MI') as old_due,
       to_char(s.due_at at time zone 'Europe/Paris', 'Dy DD Mon, HH24:MI') as new_due
from saved s
left join old o on o.id = s.id;

insert into sync_log (fetched, inserted, moved)
values ($1, $2, $3);
